mcqs.q: Which city served as the capital of the medieval Vijayanagara Empire, now a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Karnataka?
mcqs.exp: Hampi on the banks of the Tungabhadra was the capital of the Vijayanagara Empire from 1336 to 1565 AD.

mcqs.q: India's only active gold-producing mine is located in which district of Karnataka?
mcqs.exp: Hutti Gold Mines in Raichur district is currently the only operational commercial gold-producing mine in India.

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Karnataka.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Bengaluru. Karnataka covers a geographic area of 191,791 sq km across 31 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Cauvery, Krishna, Tungabhadra, Sharavathi (Jog Falls), Kabini.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Bengaluru is India's 'Silicon Valley'. Renowned for coffee, sandalwood, ISRO headquarters, and UNESCO World Heritage Sites at Hampi, Pattadakal, and the Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Karnataka.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Karnataka was formally instituted on 1 November 1956. Official language(s): Kannada (Classical Language).

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Yakshagana, Dollu Kunitha, Veeragase.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Mysuru Dasara, Karaga, Hampi Utsav, Kambala (Buffalo race).

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Karnataka.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Thawar Chand Gehlot.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Karnataka is Siddaramaiah.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under High Court of Karnataka (Bengaluru).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Asian elephant | State Bird: Indian roller | State Flower: Lotus | State Tree: Sandalwood.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Karnataka.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Gold (Hutti - only active gold mine in India), Iron Ore (Kudremukh), Manganese.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Karnataka plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Karnataka.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Hampi Monuments (Vijayanagara), Pattadakal, Hoysala Temples (Belur, Halebidu, Somanathapura), Gol Gumbaz, Mysore Palace.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Bandipur National Park, Nagarhole, Bannerghatta, Kudremukh, Anshi.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Karnataka.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Gruha Lakshmi, Yuva Nidhi, Shakthi Scheme, Anna Bhagya, Gruha Jyothi.
